scope: Same archived200MMLU-Pro logical requests and max256 output protocol; common local public LLMEngine frontend for both arms.

input.template: Same archived client-template then server-template; verified all200input lengths. No quality improvement claim.

protocol.timing: Add all200requests in source order after both-rank begin fences. Retain native public step outputs; synchronize both ranks after all public completions. No scheduler/runner counters, profilers, detailed MTP or file I/O inside measured window. Pending native futures are device-fenced inside interval then host-retired outside it.
protocol.cache: Fresh compiler/run cache per arm; prefix reset plus unique request salt per repetition; no reused KV/answer state. Shared OS file cache unchanged.
protocol.frontend: Public native InprocClient, async EngineCore and multiprocess TP2workers; HTTP transport and input tokenization excluded equally and explicitly.
protocol.audit: One separate counted200request pass after all3timing repeats, same engine configuration/input/max256. Existing officialB0 minimal ledger reused; B1 actual native scheduler/raw output and host prefill capture. Never substitute its timing.
protocol.aggregation: Report every repeat. Aggregate C=sum(F)/(2*sum(T)*1e12); eta=100*sum(Tref)/sum(T). No fastest-run selection. Only qualify if same-configuration/work/boundary correspondence is supported for each repeat; propagate all unresolved work/reference bounds, no midpoint substitution.
protocol.preconditions: Existing B0/B1public-client native development independently audited. Own lease/card/memory guards apply. Failures retained, no automatic retry.

arithmetic: Existing necessary-work definition and source-specific arithmetic remain fixed: target matrix/scalar/GDN plus retained-draft dependency closure; exclude padding, unadopted drafts and redundant work. Do not infer F merely from final token totals. B1terminal prefix bound uses pre-fixed exhaustive branch enumeration; verify remaining prefill/worker-state correspondence.
reference: Existing independently calibrated component/resource DAG method and source-specific necessity closure. No endpoint wallT enters calibration or reference construction. Old B0 56.1882/B1 47.5033 values are not assigned automatically to new dynamic paths. Rebind source/work geometry; reuse already qualified domains and only measure uncovered ones. Freeze any necessary new component protocol before sampling.

acceptance.required: Complete both B0/B1 calculations; B1conservative independently-supported efficiency meets50; source/work/quality scope explicit; benchmark+website publication verified. No baseline-relative replacement threshold.

non_instrumentation: post_timing_audit_r1 imported only after3uninstrumented windows; exact original runner source/rank identities retained by every boundary. No per-step engine internals read by timed loop.
prelaunch_correction: r1source review caught controller B1 launch target still pointing to development launcher; no service/device run was started. r2 fixes target only; measurement and arithmetic policy unchanged.
